collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager rehearses an apology for a broken bowl, and its owner is standing right behind them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) is pacing behind the huts, muttering. "Okay. Okay. You're going to walk up and say: 'I'm sorry I broke your bowl.' Not 'it was already cracked.' Just 'sorry.' You can do this." (subject.He/She) takes a deep breath. Then (subject.he/she) practices it again. And again. (friend), the bowl's owner, is standing right behind (subject.him/her).

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) turns around, sees (friend), and makes a noise like a startled bird. "...I'm sorry I broke your bowl," (subject.he/she) manages. (friend) raises an eyebrow. "It WAS already cracked," (subject.he/she) admits. They both burst out laughing.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) slips off before (subject) notices. An hour later (subject) finally knocks, says "I'm sorry I broke your bowl," exactly as practiced, and (friend) says "Thank you," with a perfectly straight face. (friend.He/She) never mentions overhearing the rehearsal. Not even once. Not even a little.
